changes.summary: Bound this recipe to the evidence-backed model capability authority without changing runtime behavior.

changes.details: The recipe now carries every author-selectable Podman build input through the signed Controller-to-agent request, including a bounded capability list that defaults to empty. The agent drops all capabilities before adding only declared allowlisted entries inside Podman's rootless user namespace; host privilege, devices, mounts, sockets, security options, storage, cgroups, and generated image identity remain fixed platform policy.
changes.summary: Declared explicit resource limits and rootless capabilities in the portable recipe build contract.
Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.

changes.details: Portrait 720x1280 and landscape 1280x720 remain available within the existing per-dimension and multiple-of-16 contract, while larger combinations such as 1280x1280 fail closed before inference. The declared 128 GB memory envelope and blocked physical single-Spark qualification remain unchanged.
changes.summary: Bounded every generation request to a 921,600-pixel canvas before either Wan-Dancer inference stage starts.
Published the canvas ceiling and retained the exact pinned upstream provenance for this local safety bound.
Rejected unknown signed-manifest slots and mismatched media types, extensions, and per-slot byte bounds before inference.
Made the exact 128 GB Controller admission envelope and offline source-bundled execution status explicit.

changes.details: The adapter validates the reference image before inference, derives its even output crop and music-bound frame contract, then requires exact H.264/AAC streams, dimensions, frame rate, frame count, and synchronized durations.
changes.summary: Made derived Wan-Dancer MP4 acceptance fail closed.

changes.details: The adapter verifies the signed manifest, consumes required prompt/image/music slots, and keeps generation controls in an optional bounded JSON slot.
changes.summary: Added signed typed prompt, reference-image, music, controls, and MP4 result slots.

changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.
changes.summary: Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
Added the complete official global-planning and local-refinement music-to-dance pipeline for one DGX Spark.
Adapted upstream sequence-parallel execution to its supported single-process path with unified-memory model offload on ARM64/CUDA 13.
Pinned every checkpoint and dependency, disabled runtime downloads, isolated image and music inputs, and verified the final H.264/AAC artifact.
